data.title: Isotope selective three-step photoionization of 174Yb
data.journal: Journal of the Optical Society of America B
data.notes: JOSA B vol. 40, no. 1, pp. 53-62 (2023). Theory paper: density matrix formalism for AVLIS of 174Yb. Three-step scheme: 6s2 1S0 (0 cm^-1) -[555.8023 nm]-> 6s6p 3P1 (17992.007 cm^-1) -[581.2273 nm]-> (4f13 6s2 6p)(7/2,3/2) J=2 (35196.98 cm^-1) -[582.88 nm]-> autoionization at 52353 cm^-1 -> Yb+. Ionization energy 50443.2 cm^-1 (6.254 eV). Radiative lifetimes of 3P1 and inner-shell levels: 840 ns and 1120 ns (from Borisov 1996). Table 2 frequency positions (isotope shifts + HFS components for all Yb isotopes, both steps) are taken entirely from ref [16] = Borisov, Kuzmina, Mishin, J. Russ. Laser Res. 17, 332-345 (1996); that paper is the primary measurement source for the 581 nm isotope shifts and should be added to the DB separately.

properties.note: FK reference level for 581.2273 nm transition; energy from scheme description p. 2. Primary source is NIST or Atkinson 2019.

properties.paper_notation_note: paper superscript '14' is a typesetting error; correct configuration is 4f13 6s2 6p based on parity (even) and energy level context

properties.note: Second step of 3-step photoionization scheme for 174Yb AVLIS (inner-shell 4f13 transition). Isotope shifts for this transition relative to 174Yb for 168,170,172,173,176Yb, and hyperfine components for 171Yb and 173Yb, are in Table 2 of this paper but originate from Borisov et al. 1996 (J. Russ. Laser Res. 17, 332-345); add a separate JSON for that paper to capture those data with correct provenance.
